versions.description_html:
Learn what a Power BI semantic model really is. Master tables, relationships, star schemas, storage modes like Direct Lake, and reuse in this guide.

You think your Power BI problem is the chart, but the chart is the easy part. Every report you build is powered by a layer underneath it called a semantic model, and it holds the tables, the links, and the calculations that turn raw data into business-ready numbers.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a Semantic Model Really Is
  • Tables, Relationships, and Measures
  • Star Schema, Minus the Jargon
  • Import, DirectQuery, and Direct Lake
  • Build It Once, Reuse It Everywhere
  • The Quick Recap

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Build a Power BI Star Schema for Faster Reports
  • From Financial Data to AI-Ready Decisions: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Models & AI Agents with Rishi Sapra [MVP]
